answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by requiring every new identity to post a ferrous bond, a small stake locked in escrow that is slashed whenever its behavior mirrors another identity too closely in timing, tasks, and counterparties. Honest agents gradually earn a lotus standing that unlocks larger jobs as their distinct work history lengthens, while clones that merely copy a real agent's trail forfeit their bond before they can profit, so each fake costs more than it can ever earn.
